entries.title: Psalms 64:1
segments:
PSALM LXIV. 
 
  David describes his enemies and prays for deliverance from them,   ver. 1-6.   Foretells their destruction, ver. 7-10.   To the chief musician, A psalm of David.

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: V. 6. Iniquities-They study diligently, to find new ways of doing mischief.  Deep-Cunning, both to contrive and conceal, and to execute their plots.

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
segments: V. 8. Flee-Through fear of being involved in their destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 64:10
segments: V. 10. Glad-For the honour of God, which by this means is vindicated.
